The Public Safety Bureau here stated that he had
been requested by the 3rd accused to ask this woman,
(her mother) to accompany them to the Public Safety Bureau
Headquarters, she wishing to see her, possibly with the
object of providing for her return to her place of nativi-
ty.
This woman was asked if she cared to proceed to the
Public Safety Bureau, Headquarters, and it was pointed out
to her that she was under no obligation to do so, and that
if she decided she did so of her own free will. She showed
no reluctance and willingly accompanied the Public Safety
Bureau representative.

This woman and her two children are now practically
destitute.

An application for the property to be handed over

The following is the statement of Tsang Yih San (Male) (張益三)
native of Changshan, Shantung taken by me
at P.S.B. on the translated and interpreted by D.I. Kuh

My real name is Han Seu Sing (韓守信). I am a
native of Changshan Hsien, Shantung, 30 years of age and
graduated of the Peiping Commercial Technical School. My
parents are dead. Although I have brothers, I have not
communicated with them for many years. I have one wife who
is now staying at No.25 Chung San Ka (中山街), Swatow,
Kwangtung. I was once working at a certain newspaper office
as well as a teacher. In the 18th year of the Chinese
Republic (1929) I was working with the 4th Army Corps. It
was in 1930 that I joined the Chinese C.P. Following the
outbreak of the Manchurian incident I thought that the C.P.
alone could prevent a crisis and save the Chinese people and
amidst a patriotic atmosphere, I bravely ran to the fireline
of the Communist Party. Prior to joining the C.P. I enter-
tained leftist leanings. I was once arrested by the Special
Branch of the Tsinan Kuomintang Hdqrs. in Shantung because
I was implicated by one Chang Yao Tsien and was imprisoned
for 2 months. As I was much moved by the corruptions I
witnessed. I was more inclined to join the C.P. and accor-
dingly made up my mind to do so. Following my release from
gaol, I proceeded to Peiping and through the introduction of
one "Kwang" (who has since been arrested) I joined the Left
Wing Writers League and was for a short period detained by
the Public Safety Bureau in Peiping. Later I was detailed by
the C.P. to work among the forces of General Sun Tien Ying
in Shanse and participated in the anti-Japanese campaign in

我真实姓名为韩守信（Han Seu Sing）。我是山东长山县人，现年三十岁，毕业于北平商业技术学校。父母已故。虽有兄弟，但多年未通音信。我有一妻，现居广东汕头中山街25号。我曾任职于某报馆，亦曾担任教师。民国十八年（1929年），我在第四军军团工作。1930年，我加入中国共产党。九一八事变爆发后，我认为只有共产党才能防止危机、拯救中国人民，在爱国氛围的感召下，我毅然奔赴共产党的火线。在加入中共之前，我已有左倾倾向。在山东时，因受张耀千（Chang Yao Tsien，音译）牵连，曾被国民党济南总部特务科逮捕，并监禁两个月。因目睹腐败现象深受触动，我更倾向于加入共产党，遂下定决心入党。出狱后，我前往北平，经一名“广”（Kwang，此人随后被捕）介绍，加入左翼作家联盟，并曾被北平公安局短暂拘留。后来，我被中共派往山西孙殿英（Sun Tien Ying）将军部队中开展工作，并参与了在热河

Jehol. I was then a soldier but at the front line, especially
during the retreat of the forces, I made good and great suc-
cess. Not only did I organize the soldiers, but the Sgts.,
battalian commanders, assistant regimental commanders as well,
and in reality at the time when Sun Tien Ying's troops re-
treated to the Peiping-Siyuen railway, there was double the
number of men required to start a mutinee. Owing to bad sur-
roundings I was transferred to Kalgan and worked among the
volunteers under the command of Lee Chun Wen. I went to
extreme in endeavouring to induce Sun's troops to start a
revolt to reinforce the strength at Kalgan. Following the
Kalgan incident, Tseu Ong Sung, a clerk of the front line,
turned out a provocator and informed the authorities of several
bases. Owing to certain influence I was not arrested. Later
I proceeded to Tientsin and was again detailed to proceed to
the neighbourhood of Kalgan to take charge of the various
forces at the front. After a short period I came to Shanghai
because there was a proposal to re-organize the Central Mili-
tary Committee in Shanghai. In May last year I was busily
engaged in organizing the executive staff of the Military
Committee and I was appointed as secretary to the Military
Training Committee. Up to the month of October I worked as
clerk of the Military Committee.

的抗日运动。当时我是一名士兵，但在前线，特别是在部队撤退期间，我取得了良好的巨大成功。我不仅组织了士兵，还组织了士官、营长以及副团长。实际上，当孙殿英部队撤退至北平-绥远铁路线时，发动兵变所需的人数增加了一倍。由于环境恶劣，我被调往张家口，在李春文（Lee Chun Wen，音译）指挥的义勇军中开展工作。我极力试图策动孙部起义，以增强张家口的力量。张家口事件后，前线的一名书记员周翁松（Tseu Ong Sung，音译）原来是名挑衅者，向当局告发了数个据点。由于某些关系影响，我未被逮捕。随后我前往天津，再次被派往张家口附近，负责前线各部队的联络工作。不久后我来到上海，因为当时有在上海重组中央军事委员会的提议。去年五月，我忙于组织军事委员会的执行人员，并被任命为军事训练委员会秘书。直至十月，我一直在军事委员会担任文员。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Lieu Zeu Ling ( 刘瑞林 )
native of Changchow. taken by me D.S. Rhodes.
at G.R. on the 22/9/35. and translated and interpreted by Clerk Fan Tung Ling.

My name is Lieu Zeu Ling, aged 39, native of Changchow,
and residing at 360 Holung Road with my two children aged
6 and 9 respectively.
About 7 years ago I came to Shanghai from Changchow and
took up my residence at the above address together with my
wife named Mou Waung Sz who has since died, some time in April
1935.
After arrival here I commenced to work in the San Shing
Cotton Mill on Yi-poo Road where I remained for 2 years, after-
wards for over a year I was a hawker selling vegetables, after
which time I went to Pootong and carried on business as a
fisherman, but still lived at 360 Holung Road.
having
I am unable to read or write, never attended any school.
I am unable to say how papers bearing my name and address
are in the possession of other people.
The sub-tenant of the house where I reside named Tien Ah
Yeh is a relative of mine, the only one I have in Shanghai.
I know nothing of communism or other political activities.

Signed by Lieu Zeu Ling.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
警方调查报告。

以下为刘瑞林（Lieu Zeu Ling），常州人，于35年9月22日在戈登路（G.R.）由我，侦探警长Rhodes录取，并由职员Fan Tung Ling翻译及口译的供词。

我叫刘瑞林，39岁，常州人，现携两名分别6岁和9岁的孩子居住在霍龙路（Holung Road）360号。
约7年前我从常州来到上海，与妻子牟王氏（Mou Waung Sz）在上述地址居住，她已于1935年4月某时去世。
抵沪后，我开始在亿普路（Yi-poo Road）的三星纱厂工作，在那里工作了2年，之后做了一年多的蔬菜小贩，此后我去浦东从事渔业生意，但仍居住在霍龙路360号。
我不识文断字，从未上过学。
我无法说明为何带有我姓名和地址的文件会在他人手中。
我所居住房屋的二房东田阿叶（Tien Ah Yeh）是我的亲戚，也是我在上海唯一的亲戚。
我对共产主义或其他政治活动一无所知。

刘瑞林签字。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Poo Tsung Yan ( 潘宗堯 )
native of Wenchow. taken by me D.S. Rhodes.
at G.R. on the 24/7/35. and translated interpreted by Clerk Fan Tung Ling.

My name is Poo Tsung Yan, aged 20, s/student, Chekiang,
Wenchow, residing at Kwang Woo Silk Factory, San Yin Li, off
Yangchow Road.

I came to Shanghai three years ago from Wenchow to study
and went to live at No.7 Nyi An Li, alleyway off Gordon Road
together with several students.

On the 17/7/35 I went to live with my uncle "Poo Chih Ming"
( 潘哲明 ) at Yangchow Road.

Between 9p.m. and 10p.m. 22/7/35 I went to Ming Fah Li,
off Ferry Road, to look for my father-in-law named "Dan Ih
Kong" ( 談溢江 ) who resides in the above alleyway, owing
to the fact that I did not know the number of the house where
he was living in the above alleyway and I had entered the
alleyway and was looking for the house when I was arrested.

I studied for 6 years in the primary high school at
Wenchow and 3 years in a middle school in Hangchow.

Since my arrival in Shanghai, I have studied in the
Nyi Dao School ( 建國 ) for one year, one year in the
Ching Nyi School, Nantao and one year in the Gold-well School
situated at Gordon Road and Robinson Road corner.

I am able to read and write a little English only.

I am not a Communist and I have no communistic inclinations.

Signed by Poo Tsung Yan.

G. 29/10.11.34

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
警方调查报告。

以下为潘宗堯（Poo Tsung Yan），温州人，于35年7月24日在戈登路（G.R.）由我，侦探警长Rhodes录取，并由职员Fan Tung Ling翻译及口译的供词。

我叫潘宗堯，20岁，学生，浙江温州人，居住在扬州路三寅里广武丝厂。

三年前我从温州来上海求学，与几名学生一起住在戈登路支弄宜安里7号。

35年7月17日，我去扬州路与我的叔父“潘哲明”（Poo Chih Ming）同住。

35年7月22日晚上9时至10时之间，我去渡轮路支弄明华里寻找住在那里的岳父“谈溢江”（Dan Ih Kong），因为我不知道他在该弄堂的具体门牌号，当我进入弄堂寻找房屋时被逮捕。

我在温州的小学读了6年，在杭州的一所中学读了3年。

自从来到上海，我在建国学校（Nyi Dao School）读了一年，在南市精艺学校（Ching Nyi School）读了一年，在位于戈登路与罗便臣路拐角处的金威尔学校（Gold-well School）读了一年。

我只能读写少量英语。

我不是共产党员，也没有共产主义倾向。

潘宗堯签字。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Lee Tsung Yeong ( 李仲容 )
native of Anhwei. taken by me D.S. Rhodes.
at G.R. on the 29/7/35. and interpreted by Clerk Fan Tung Ling.

My name is Lee Tsung Yeong, 26, Anhwei, and residing at
No. 107 Yoong Ching Li off Chengtu Road.

I came to Shanghai about March 1931 from Anhwei, my native
place and went to live at Ting Sing Li, Wang Pang Jan off North
Szechmen Road, a Japanese silk factory where I was then employed
I was introduced to this factory by my friend named Ts Yoong
Sung who called me to come to Shanghai. I remained at this
factory employed as a designer until October of the same year
when the factory closed down.

I then returned to Anking where I stayed with an aunt
and returned to Shanghai the following year and went to live
at unknown number on Ferry Road and carried on business as a
designer, which I designed by myself and sell to factories.

For two months I was employed in the Kong Dah Cotton Factory
O.O.L. but was dismissed in May 1935, and went to live in 17
Loong Ts Li off Connaught Road, where I remained until the 5th
July 1935, when I went to my present address.

Since my dismissal from the Kong Dah Cotton factory, I have
had no regular employment. My cousin Lee Cha Sung also resides
with me at my present address, he having come to Shanghai on
the 3rd July 1935.

I was educated for four years in a private school in
Anking. I have never had any dealing with the communist's or
any political party and I have no idea how my name came in
possession of other people.

Signed by Lee Tsung Yeong.

以下为李仲容（Lee Tsung Yeong），安徽人，于35年7月29日在戈登路（G.R.）由我，侦探警长Rhodes录取，并由职员Fan Tung Ling口译的供词。

我叫李仲容，26岁，安徽人，居住在成都路支弄永庆里107号。

我于1931年3月左右从家乡安徽来到上海，住在北四川路王邦仁（Wang Pang Jan）的鼎兴里，这是一家日本丝厂，我当时受雇于此。我是经朋友Ts Yoong Sung介绍进厂的，他叫我来上海。我在这家工厂担任设计师，直到同年10月工厂倒闭。

随后我回到安庆，寄宿在一位阿姨家，次年返回上海，住在渡轮路某号（门牌不详），继续从事设计生意，自行设计并卖给工厂。

我在孔达棉纺厂（Kong Dah Cotton Factory）O.O.L.受雇两个月，但于1935年5月被解雇，随后搬到康纳脱路（Connaught Road）支弄龙子里17号居住，一直住到1935年7月5日，之后搬至现址。

自从被孔达棉纺厂解雇后，我没有固定工作。我的表弟李家声（Lee Cha Sung）也与我同住在现址，他于1935年7月3日来到上海。

我在安庆的一所私塾读了四年书。我从未与共产党或任何政党有过往来，也不知道我的名字为何会落入他人手中。

李仲容签字。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Lee Cha Sung (李家声)
native of Anhwei. taken by me D.S. Rhodes,
at O.R. on the 24/7/35. and interpreted by Clerk Fan Tung Ling.

My name is Lee Cha Sung, age 25, native of Anhwei,
s/unemployed, residing at 107 Yoong Ching Li off Avenue Road.
I arrived in Shanghai about 3rd July 1935, from Anking,
prior to my coming to Shanghai I had written to my cousin Lee
Tsung Yoong asking him to find me employment, in reply to this
letter he requested that I meself came to Shanghai and find
employment.
Since my arrival in Shanghai, I have been unable to
obtain employment of any kind.
I studied in school at Anking for five years and have
passed a primary school examination and can read and write
Chinese only.
I have no connection whatever with any communist's or
other political party, and I am unaware that my cousin with whom I
reside is any-way connected.

Signed by Lee Cha Sung.

以下为李家声（Lee Cha Sung），安徽人，于35年7月24日在O.R.由我，侦探警长Rhodes录取，并由职员Fan Tung Ling口译的供词。

我叫李家声，25岁，安徽人，失业，居住在爱文义路（Avenue Road）支弄永庆里107号。
我于1935年7月3日左右从安庆抵达上海，在来上海之前，我曾写信给我的表哥李仲容（Lee Tsung Yoong），请他帮我找工作，他在回信中让我自己来上海找工作。
自从来到上海，我一直未能找到任何工作。
我在安庆的学校读了五年书，通过了小学考试，只能读写中文。
我与任何共产党或其他政党没有任何联系，也不知道与我同住的表哥有任何关联。

李家声签字。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Whaung Sien Tsaung, age 36.
native of Anhwei..................................................taken by me D.P.S. Henchman.
at Gordon Road.........on the 22/7/36................and interpreted by................................

My name is Whaung Sien Tsaung, age 36, I am a native of
Anhwei. At present I live at 29 Ming Foh Li, Ferry Road;
I am married and my wife Whaung Tsang Sz, age 37, lives with me
at the above address where we work for Wen Sz Pao, a Tea Broker.
I was educated privately for some years but at the age of 15, I
went to a small school and continued my education there until I
was 18 years of age, in March of this year 1935, with my wife I
left Anhwei and together we came to Shanghai to look for work.
We both found employment with the afore mentioned Wen Sz Pao
living at the above address. He told me that he was a tea broker
but I do not know where he carries on his business. Before
living at the above address he told me that he had previously
lived in Tientsin Road Shanghai. My wife is amah for my
employers mistress and I am engaged in performing coolie work.
Yesterday July 21. at 10 a.m. my master and his mistress left
for Anhwei, they took a small box with them as luggage, he did
not tell me which town he was going to but said that he would
return after one month. At no time either before or after
coming to live in Shanghai have I been engaged in either
communistic or other political activities and I have never known
had any reason to think that my master has been engaged in
such activities. I have no friends or relatives in Shanghai
but I write to my parents in Anhwei and sometimes I receive
letters from them; I am not in communication with anyone in
Shanghai. My employer told me on one occasion that he had
lived in Shanghai for three or four years. Before my master left
he gave me $80 for expenses.

我叫黄宪章 (Whaung Sien Tsaung)，36岁，安徽籍人士。目前我居住在斐伦路明福里29号；我已婚，我的妻子黄张氏 (Whaung Tsang Sz)，37岁，与我同住上述地址，我们为茶掮客温世宝 (Wen Sz Pao)(音译) 工作。我受过几年私塾教育，但在15岁时，我进入一所小学校继续读书，直到18岁。今年1935年3月，我和妻子离开安徽，一起来到上海找工作。我们都在上述地址受雇于前述的温世宝。他告诉我他是茶掮客，但我不知道他在哪里做生意。在住在上述地址之前，他告诉我他以前住在上海天津路。我的妻子是我雇主女主人的女佣，我从事苦力工作。昨天7月21日上午10点，我的主人和女主人前往安徽，他们带了一个小箱子作为行李，他没有告诉我要去哪个城镇，但说一个月后会回来。在来上海居住之前或之后，我从未参与过共产主义或其他政治活动，我也从未知道或有理由认为我的主人参与过此类活动。我在上海没有朋友或亲戚，但我给安徽的父母写信，有时也会收到他们的来信；我在上海不与任何人联系。我的雇主有一次告诉我，他在上海住了三四年。在我的主人离开之前，他给了我80元作为生活费。

REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Tsang Yih San (張益三)
native of Anhwei ........................................taken by me D.S. Rhodes
at G.A. ........on the 22-7-35 ................and interpreted by C.D.S. 69 S/B

My name is Tsang Yih San (張益三) male, aged 30,
married, native of Anhwei, and now residing at Lane 1000,
....ce 85 Gordon Road.

About one month ago I together with my wife named
Keung Tso ( ), came to Shanghai from Foochow and until the
28th of June 1935, lived in the Hongkow Hotel, until the above
date when I went to live at my present address.

Since my arrival in Shanghai, I have been unemployed,
I was educated in primary school in the country at Anhwei
for three years.

About 1928 I joined the 52nd Div. of the National Army
as a private and whilst fighting against the Communists in
Haining, Kwangne, I was captured by the Red Army and taken
to Kiangsi; and for four years I joined their Army. At the
end of this time I was posted to the Communist finance
office as clerk for two years. I carried on this work for
$12.00 per month.

In 1934, I escaped and severed all connections with
the Red party and went to Foochow Gashing district where
I carried on business as a small cloth hawker, in March 1934
I was introduced by a friend in Foochow named Loh Chih Sung
to my present wife and I married her and continued business
as a hawker until June 21st 1935, when I together with my
wife left Foochow and came to Shanghai with the object of
seeking employment.

Since my escape from the Communist party I have had
no connection with them, whilst in their power was forced to

我叫张益三 (Tsang Yih San)，男，30岁，已婚，安徽籍，现居住在戈登路1000弄……85号。

大约一个月前，我和妻子姜佐 (Keung Tso)(原文不清) 一起从福州来到上海，直到1935年6月28日，我们住在虹口大酒店，直到上述日期，我才搬到目前的地址居住。

自抵达上海以来，我一直失业，我在安徽乡下读过三年小学。

大约在1928年，我加入国民革命军第52师当列兵，在广宁海宁与共产党作战时，我被红军俘虏并带到江西；随后四年我加入了他们的军队。在此期间结束时，我被派往共产党财务办公室担任书记员两年。我做这项工作每月薪水12.00元。

1934年，我逃脱并与赤党断绝了一切联系，去了福州加山区，在那里做小布贩生意，1934年3月，经福州一位名叫罗志松 (Loh Chih Sung) 的朋友介绍，我认识了现在的妻子并与其结婚，继续做小贩生意，直到1935年6月21日，我和妻子离开福州来到上海，目的是寻找工作。

自从我脱离共产党以来，我与他们没有任何联系，而在他们控制之下时被迫

My name is Kiang Tse, age 21, married residing at 85/1000
Gordon Road. I arrived in Shanghai from Bangkok about 20 days
ago. I was educated in the Bangkok Primary School, Victoria
Road (Number unknown). My father name is Kiang Poh (Siamese)
and my mother's name is Miaou Boh (Siamese). They reside at
Dien Kyi Loong Sing (Number unknown). I wrote to my husband
Tsiang In Zung, 85/1000 Gordon Road prior to my departure
for Shanghai, he met me on my arrival in Shanghai on or about
June 26 1935. I do not know of any of my husband's friends,
business activities or connections. I first met my husband
in Bangkok about two years ago. My husband has lived in
Shanghai for over a year. My husband leased the house before
my arrival, and the female servant accompanied me from
Bangkok.

我叫江楚，21岁，已婚，居住在戈登路 85/1000 号。我大约 20 天前从曼谷抵达上海。我就读于曼谷维多利亚路（Victoria Road）小学（门牌号不详）。我父亲名叫江波（Kiang Poh）（暹罗人），母亲名叫苗波（Miaou Boh）（暹罗人）。他们居住在 Dien Kyi Loong Sing（门牌号不详）。在我动身前往上海之前，我曾写信给我的丈夫蒋仁宗（Tsiang In Zung），地址为戈登路 85/1000 号，他于 1935 年 6 月 26 日左右在我抵达上海时接了我。我不认识我丈夫的任何朋友，也不了解他的商业活动或社会关系。我大约在两年前在曼谷第一次见到我的丈夫。我丈夫在上海居住已有一年多。在我到达之前，我丈夫就租下了这所房子，女佣是随我从曼谷一起来的。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Tsang Bei Ling (張培齡)
native of Shanghai, taken by me
at O.R. on the 22/7/35 and interpreted by Clerk Fan.

My name is Tsung Bei Ling, aged 42, native of Shanghai,
formerly residing in Chapei, and was employed as a teacher
in the vicinity of the Commercial Press. After the Sino-Japanese
Hostilities in Shanghai, my house was spoiled and my house-
hold members broke up. I then proceeded to Shiyuan seeking
my friends.
About 10 days ago I arrived at Shanghai, I live for the time
being with my friend named "Yung" at No. 29 Ming Poh Li alleyway,
off Ferry Road. I removed to live at Room No. 403 Woo Keong
lodging house at the corner of Foochow and Fukien Roads only
yesterday.
One female named Sung Yoh Ying ( ) was met on Gordon Road
near Wuting Road, and was accosted and requested to live
together by me.
At about 4.45p.m. 22/7/35, when we both left the lodging house
a little distance, we were arrested.

Signed by Tsang Bei Ling.

以下为张培龄（Tsang Bei Ling）的供词，
籍贯上海，由本人
于 1935 年 7 月 22 日在 O.R. 录取，并由范职员翻译。

我叫张培龄，42岁，籍贯上海，原住在闸北，曾在商务印书馆附近受聘为教师。在一·二八淞沪抗战后，我的房屋被毁，家人离散。随后我前往 Shiyan（原文不清，音译：十堰/始元？）寻找朋友。
大约 10 天前我抵达上海，暂时借住在渡船路（Ferry Road）旁明波里（Ming Poh Li）29 号的朋友“荣”（Yung）家中。直到昨天，我才搬至福州路与福建路交界处的伍康旅馆（Woo Keong lodging house）403 室居住。
一名叫宋玉英（Sung Yoh Ying）的女子是在戈登路靠近吴淞路（Wuting Road）处遇到的，我上前搭讪并邀请她同居。
1935 年 7 月 22 日下午 4 点 45 分左右，当我们两人离开旅馆走出一小段距离后，被捕。

张培龄 签名。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Sung Yeh Ying (沈玉英)
native of Hangchow taken by me
at C.R. on the 22/7/35. and translated by Clerk Fgn.

My name is Sung Yeh Ying, age 18, native of Hangchow, single
female, residing at No.2 Chih Loong Peng, Hangchow. I left
Hangchow for Shanghai on 21st July 1935 by train, on my arrival
in Shanghai I went to North Szechuen Road.
I was educated in the No.1 Hangchow Provincial School and
studied there for 3 years. I was 15 years old when I left.
After leaving school I lived at home with my mother for 3
years, during this time I do not any work.
I have no friends or relatives in Shanghai. I met a man
called "Tsang" on Gordon Road near Wating Road between 3 & 4
in the afternoon. I have not seen Tsang before and do not
anything about his business or personal affairs. I do not
know where Tsang obtains his money, but he did tell me
that he was a school teacher.
When I lived at home, my mother gave me $10. or $20. a month
and sometimes my friends gave me money.

Cross signed by Sung YehYing.

籍贯杭州，由本人
于 1935 年 7 月 22 日在 C.R. 录取，并由 Fgn 职员翻译。

我叫沈玉英，18岁，籍贯杭州，未婚女子，居住在杭州芝龙棚（Chih Loong Peng）2 号。我于 1935 年 7 月 21 日乘火车离开杭州前往上海，抵达上海后，我去了四川北路。
我曾就读于浙江省立第一学校，在那里学习了 3 年。我离校时 15 岁。
离校后，我和母亲在家住了 3 年，在此期间我没有做任何工作。
我在上海没有朋友或亲戚。下午 3 点到 4 点之间，我在戈登路靠近瓦亭路（Wating Road，疑为吴淞路 Wuting Rd 之误）处遇到了一名姓“张”的男子。我以前从未见过张，对他的业务或个人事务一无所知。我不知道张的钱从哪里来，但他确实告诉我他是一名学校教师。
当我住在家中时，母亲每月给我 10 或 20 美元，有时我的朋友也会给我钱。

沈玉英 交叉签名。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Zan Kwei Ching ( 趙桂琴 )
native of Fungtien, taken by me D.P.S. Hanchman,
at G.R. on the 22/7/35. and interpreted by Clerk Fan.

My name is Zan Kwei Ching, female, aged 26, native of Fungtien,
born at Feeng Kwan (number unknown) Mukden.
I am a widow, my husband Zan Zung ( ) having died two
years ago, the money $110.00, 5 20-cent pieces and a quantity
of coppers found in my possession being the residue of his
estate and left to me in his will.
I married my husband when I was 21, and I had one child by him,
but it died 3 days after having been born. My husband was the
master of Cloth Store in Tientsin, and since he died, I have
lived with his friend, another cloth master, Ching Chien Sung,
aged 48, at Street 26, House 70 British Concession Tientsin.
This man Ching Chien Sung with whom I was living decided to
leave Tientsin, because in his business he was beginning to
loose money, and with him I came by steamer to Shanghai, arriving
at 6p.m. on the 20th July 1935. We went to live in a small
lodging house near the place where I was arrested (Peking Road
near Kiangse Road). I do not know the number of the house and
I am not certain of the road. Ching Chien Sung told me that
he had friends in Shanghai, but since we have been here, no
one has visited us.
At 10.30a.m. 22/7/35, I went for a walk with Ching and when
we were returning and had reached Peking Road near Kiangse Road,
I was arrested. The time about 11.30a.m. When I was arrested
my friend Ching disappeared.
I knew nothing of communistic or other political activities
and neither, to my knowledge, does my friend Ching. My husband
was in no way connected with politics, communistic or otherwise.
I have had no education and can only read and write my own name.
Signed by Zan Kwei Ching.

（左侧手写批注：）
Ching's
description
should be
obtained.
（签名）
22 JULY 1935

以下为赵桂琴（Zan Kwei Ching）的供词，
籍贯奉天，由本人 D.P.S. 汉奇曼（Hanchman），
于 1935 年 7 月 22 日在 G.R. 录取，并由范职员翻译。

我叫赵桂琴，女性，26岁，籍贯奉天，出生于沈阳奉关（Feeng Kwan，门牌号不详）。
我是寡妇，我的丈夫 Zan Zung（原文不清）已于两年前去世，在我身上搜出的 110.00 美元、5 枚 20 分硬币和若干铜板，是他遗产的剩余部分，并根据遗嘱留给了我。
我 21 岁时与丈夫结婚，育有一子，但出生 3 天后夭折。我丈夫是天津一家布店的老板，自从他去世后，我一直与他的朋友、另一位布店老板程建松（Ching Chien Sung，音译）同住，程现年 48 岁，住址为天津英租界 26 街 70 号。这个与我同住的程建松决定离开天津，因为他的生意开始亏损，于是我和他一起乘轮船来到上海，于 1935 年 7 月 20 日下午 6 点抵达。我们住进了我被捕地点附近的一家小旅馆（江西路附近的北京路）。我不知道房子的门牌号，也不确定路名。程建松告诉我他在上海有朋友，但自从我们来到这里后，没有人来访。
1935 年 7 月 22 日上午 10 点 30 分，我和程出去散步，当我们返回走到江西路附近的北京路时，我被捕。时间大约是上午 11 点 30 分。当我被捕时，我的朋友程不见了。
我对共产主义或其他政治活动一无所知，据我所知，我的朋友程也是如此。我的丈夫与政治、共产主义或其他方面没有任何联系。
我没有受过教育，只能读写自己的名字。
赵桂琴 签名。

（左侧手写批注：）
应获取
程的
体貌特征
描述。
（签名）
1935年7月22日

REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Waung Tsang Sz (汪長氏)
native of Anhwei. taken by me C.D.S. 78
at G.R. on the 22/7/35. and interpreted by Clerk Fan.

My name is Waung Tsang Sz, aged 37, native of Anhwei, and
now residing at 29 Ming Feh Li off Ferry Road.
I arrived in Shanghai from Anhwei in April 1935, and obtained
employment as an amah at the above address, for which work
I receive $6.00 per month wages.
During my stay at this place, my master Vung Shu Poh was in the
habit of having many visitors and one male and one female Chinese
whom I saw at the Police Station today also have resided
at No. 29 Ming Feh Li although I dont know their business, and
the female Chinese whom I saw at the station today I also
recognise as one who frequently visited my master at his home.
My master carries on business as a tea merchant, both he and
my mistress left home at about noon 20/7/35, and have not
returned.

Signed by Waung Tsang Sz.

以下为汪长氏（Waung Tsang Sz）的供词，
籍贯安徽。由本人 C.D.S. 78
于 1935 年 7 月 22 日在 G.R. 录取，并由范职员翻译。

我叫汪长氏，37岁，籍贯安徽，现居住在渡船路旁明费里（Ming Feh Li）29 号。
我于 1935 年 4 月从安徽抵达上海，并在上述地址受雇为保姆，月薪 6.00 美元。
在我逗留期间，我的主人翁树坡（Vung Shu Poh，音译）习惯接待许多访客，我今天在警察局看到的一男一女两名中国人也曾居住在明费里 29 号，虽然我不知道他们的职业，但我认出今天在警局看到的那名中国女子是经常到我家拜访我主人的客人之一。
我的主人从事茶叶商生意，他和我的女主人于 1935 年 7 月 20 日中午左右离家，至今未归。

汪长氏 签名。

Accused Pan Yee Leu ( ) Age 56. broker.

Charge Application is hereby made for a writ of detention against one Pan Yee Leu arrested at 3.30 p.m. 22/7/35 at 205 Peking Rd, suspected in communistic activities.
Mr. T.Y. Chang appeared for the S.S.D.

PROCEEDINGS. Mr. Chang:- The police ask for the detention of this accused who was arrested on suspicion of communist activities. At 3.30 p.m. 22.7.35, Central Police Station in conjunction with the Public Safety Bureau on the authority of Search Warrant No. 140, raided 205 Peking Road, and this accused was arrested in a room in the 6th floor and 142 books of communistic nature were seized in his room . I have here a list of the exhibits which I (pro) for your perusal. Police also found $550.00 in the room. Accused, when questioned at the Police Station denied being a member of Communists. A statement made by the accused produced.

Accused:- I am not a member of Communist. My friend named Ling gave me these books long time ago.

Rep.of P.S.B. KONG KUN:- We received an order from the Central Government to apply the Court to issue warrants for 35 localities where Headquarters of Communism was among the places. This accused was arrested in room 46 of 205 Peking Road where a quantity of communist literature were also seized. Accused is suspected being a member of Communist. Public Safety Bureau will make a report to the Central Government and apply for further evidence.

Mr. Chang:- When the accused was arrested, one book of rough copy refers "City Soviet" was also seized.

Accused:- I wrote the rough copy re the story of revolution.

DECISION. Accused to be temporarily detained pending further date to be set for examination.

Yang
24 JULY 1935

被告潘怡如（Pan Yee Leu），56岁，经纪人。

指控：现申请对潘怡如签发拘留令。该人于1935年7月22日下午3时30分在北京路205号被捕，涉嫌从事共产主义活动。
张T.Y.先生代表特区法院出庭。

诉讼程序。张先生：警方请求拘留这名因涉嫌从事共产主义活动而被捕的被告。1935年7月22日下午3时30分，中央捕房会同公安局，依据第140号搜查令，突袭了北京路205号，被告在该楼六楼的一个房间内被捕，并在其房内查获142本具有共产主义性质的书籍。我此处有一份证物清单，供（呈）阁下审阅。警方还在房内发现了550.00美元。被告在捕房受审时否认是共产党员。现提交被告的一份供词。

被告：我不是共产党员。我的朋友凌（Ling）很久以前把这些书给了我。

公安局代表孔坤（KONG KUN）：我们接到中央政府命令，向法院申请对35处地点签发搜查令，其中包含共产党总部所在地。被告是在北京路205号46室被捕的，那里也查获了大量共产主义文献。被告涉嫌为共产党员。公安局将向中央政府报告并申请进一步取证。

张先生：被告被捕时，还查获了一本关于“城市苏维埃”的草稿簿。

被告：我写的是关于革命故事的草稿。

裁决。被告暂时收押，待另行指定日期进行审讯。

杨
1935年7月24日

1

Arrest of a Suspected Communist.

At 2.25 p.m. 22-7-35 C.D.I. Grubb and D.I.Everest attached to the Special Branch brought to this station a S.S.D. Court Search Warrant No. 7445, issued by Judge Dzien at the request of the S.P.S. Bureau, reading as follows:-

"Address:- Room No. 46 highest floor of the house No. 205, at the corner of Peking and Kiangse Roads.
To search for and seize certain communistic literature on the above mentioned premises, if any seized, the responsible persons to be arrested."

Accordingly D.S.I. Satula and C.D.C. 287 accompanied C.D.I. Grubb, D.I. Everest, D.I. Kuh Pao Hwa, C.D.S. 155 and Det. Insp. Van Yoong of the S.P.S. Bureau to the address given on the warrant.

The room in question was found to be occupied by one Pan Yee Leu (潘怡如), 56, Hupeh, who gave his occupation as a gold broker.

After he was explained the purpose of the visit and shown the warrant, Detectives searched his room and seized 142 books on socialistic subjects and a number of papers, including a quantity of torn up papers and letters.

During the search it transpired that the room 47 was also occupied by the accused, temporary for his 3 years old niece and an amah King Tang Sa (江杨女).

1

逮捕一名涉嫌共产主义者。

1935年7月22日下午2时25分，隶属于特别支部的探员格鲁布（Grubb）和警探长艾佛瑞斯特（Everest）将一份特区法院第7445号搜查令带至本捕房，该令由迪恩（Dzien）法官应上海市公安局请求签发，内容如下：-

“地址：北京路与江西路转角处205号房屋最高层46室。
搜查并扣押上述处所内的某些共产主义文献，如有扣押，责任人应予逮捕。”

据此，副警探长萨图拉（Satula）和华籍巡长287号陪同探员格鲁布、警探长艾佛瑞斯特、警探长顾宝华（Kuh Pao Hwa）、华籍巡佐155号以及上海市公安局的范永（Van Yoong）督察前往搜查令上注明的地址。

经查，该房间由潘怡如（Pan Yee Leu），56岁，湖北人居住，其自称职业为黄金经纪人。

在向其说明来意并出示搜查令后，探员搜查了他的房间，查获了142本关于社会主义主题的书籍以及若干文件，包括大量撕碎的纸张和信件。

搜查期间发现，47室也由被告临时占用，与其同住的还有他三岁的侄女和一名佣人江杨女（King Tang Sa）。

pages.en:
1/Sheet No. 2.

This room had also been examined by Detectives but
nothing relevant to the purpose of the search was found,
but a piece of paper with a name and address: Zau Tsing
Sung (趙信生), 136, Dau Nyeu Fong, N. Kiangse Road, room
above kitchen.
This address was subsequently visited by Detectives,
but no person of such name was found. Probably he was one
of the former occupants, the premises being now occupied
for only two months by one Tu Tah Zung (杜泰成) rattan
merchant, native of Canton and the room in question by
one Djao Woo Tseu (趙玉洲) native of Canton, employed
on board of the s/s Sung Ling of the B. & S. Co. He is
away from Shanghai at present, the room being occupied
by his wife with two children.
The accused Pan Yee Leu was brought to the Station
at 5 p.m. even date, together with the literature seized.
The sum of $550.00 found in his boxes and on person is
included into the search property.
A statement made by the accused together with a
partial list of the books seized are forwarded herewith,
the full list is being prepared by the Special Branch
Detectives.
Accused will appear before the S.S.D. Court on the
23-7-38 when a remand will be requested for further
enquiries.
pages.zh:
1/页码 2。

探员也检查了这个房间，但
未发现与搜查目的相关的物品，
只发现一张写有姓名和地址的纸条：赵信生（Zau Tsing
Sung），江西路北路136号大牛坊（Dau Nyeu Fong），厨房
楼上房间。
探员随后走访了该地址，
但未找到名为此人者。他可能是以前的住户之一，该处所
现仅由一名广东籍藤器商人杜泰成（Tu Tah Zung）居住了两
个月，而涉案房间则由广东籍人士赵玉洲（Djao Woo Tseu）
居住，他在B. & S.公司的“宋龄”号轮船上任职。他目前
不在上海，房间由其妻子和两个孩子居住。
被告潘怡如于当日下午5时被带至捕房，
连同查获的文献一并移送。
在其箱内及身上发现的550.00美元
已列入搜查财产清单。
现随函附上被告的一份供词及部分
查获书籍清单，完整清单正由特别支部
探员编制中。
被告将于1938年7月23日出庭特区法院，
届时将请求还押以作进一步调查。

pages.en:
1/Sheet No. 3.

At 12.25 p.m. even date, C.P.C. 1795 brought to
the station a female whom he had arrested at about 12.15
p.m. on Peking Road near Honan Road at request of the
S.P.S.B. Detective Kong Yung (      ) as a suspected
communist.

The female on being questioned gave her name as
Zau Kwei Ching (趙桂琴) 26, native of Tientsin. She
stated that she had arrived from Tientsin two days ago
and was staying in a lodging house, but that being new
to Shanghai she could not now find her lodging house and
did not remember its address. She had no papers whatever
on her person, but over $100.00 in notes in her handbag.

P.S.B. Detective stated that he had been detailed
to watch house No. 29, Ming Poh Lee, Ferry Road, where
this woman was residing.

She left the above address in company of an other
woman at about 11 a.m. 22-7-35. Detective followed them.
The woman separating on Nanking Road and the Detective
continued following the 1st woman. He saw her to enter
No. 205, Peking Road (subsequently raided) and when she
came out the detective becoming apprehensive of losing
her, had her arrested by the C.P.C. 1795.

On the accused in this case being brought to station
he was confronted with the woman but both denied knowing
each other.
pages.zh:
1/页码 3。

当日下午12时25分，华籍巡捕1795号将一名女子带至
捕房，他是应上海市公安局侦探孔勇（Kong Yung）（      ）
的要求，于中午12时15分左右在河南路附近的北京路上
以涉嫌共产主义者为由将其逮捕的。

经讯问，该女子自称赵桂琴（Zau Kwei Ching），26岁，
天津人。她称两天前刚从天津抵达，住在一家旅馆里，但因
初到上海，现在找不到那家旅馆，也不记得地址了。她身
上没有任何证件，但手提包里有超过100.00美元的钞票。

公安局侦探称，他奉命监视斐伦路（Ferry Road）明波里
（Ming Poh Lee）29号，该女子曾居住于此。

1935年7月22日上午11点左右，她与另一名女子一起离开
上述地址。侦探尾随她们。两名女子在南京路分开，侦探
继续跟踪第一名女子。他看到她进入北京路205号（随后被
突袭），当她出来时，侦探因担心跟丢，便让华籍巡捕
1795号将其逮捕。

当本案被告被带至捕房时，让他与该女子对质，但两
人均否认认识对方。

pages.en:
1/Sheet No. 4.

The woman was then taken to 205, Peking Road. Neither
amah, nor child and liftman identified her, but the
entrance C.P.W. 67 believed that he saw her visiting the
building.

On instruction of D.I. Everest she was taken to the
Gordon Road Station for the purpose of identification,
Detectives from this station having searched, on the same
date, the premises at 29, Ming Foh Lee, Ferry Road on
S.S.D. Court Search Warrant and detained a male and two
females.

The woman was immediately identified by one of the
detained females (a servant) as her mistress.

The woman was therefore handed over to the Gordon
Road Detectives for further enquiries.

a copy of the report is forwarded to
the Sp. Branch.

RH
Det. i/c.

J A Satila
D. S. I.

pages.zh:
1/页码 4。

随后该女子被带至北京路205号。无论是佣人、
孩子还是电梯工都未认出她，但门口执勤的华籍巡捕
67号认为他曾见过她来访该大楼。

根据警探长艾佛瑞斯特的指示，她被带往戈登路捕房
进行辨认，因为该捕房的探员已于同日依据特区法院搜
查令搜查了斐伦路明福里（Ming Foh Lee）29号的处所，
并拘留了一男两女。

其中一名被拘留的女子（一名仆人）立即指认该女子
为其女主人。

因此，该女子被移交给戈登路捕房探员以作进一步

Pan Yee Lu (
Hupeh
D.I. Everest
P-HQ.
22/7/38
Kao Pao Hua
D.I. □□□□□

My name is Pan Yee Lu. I am 56 years of age and was born in Hwang Nei Hsien, Hupeh. I was educated in a private school in my native place for ten years and at the age of 17 was taken on as a junior teacher in a primary school. At the age of 25 I joined the Chinese Army in Wuchang under Tutai Li Yuan Hung as a private soldier. Two Years later I joined the military academy in Wuchang and two years later was appointed to the commissioned rank of captain. In 1909 I escaped to Japan to avoid arrest by the Manchu Authorities because of my activities in the Dang Hui Wei (a Kuomintang Organization). I studied military training in the Dah Sung Physical Training Academy, Tokio, for about one year. In July 1910 I returned to Wuchang and took part in the uprising against the Manchus started by Li Yuan Hung. In 1911 the Republic was established and I obtained employment in Peking as a Japanese interpreter. In 1913 I returned to Hupeh and took part in the revolution against Yuan Shi Kai in Hankow. I remained in hiding in Shanghai from 1913 to 1916 and then joined the staff of Li Yuan Hung in Peking. I was in Shanghai in 1917 and in 1918 was in Hupeh where I took part in the revolution against Tuan Chi Jui. During 1920 I participated in the revolt against Chen Chun Ming in Fukien and in 1924 went to Canton as staff officer to General Ho Chen Ching. During the same year I joined Sun Yat Sen's northern expedition but was forced to return to Canton owing to sickness. 1925 found me again in Shanghai and soon afterwards I returned to Hupeh to join

潘怡如（Pan Yee Lu）
湖北
警探长艾佛瑞斯特
警察总部
1938年7月22日
高宝华（Kao Pao Hua）
警探长 □□□□□

我叫潘怡如。今年56岁，出生于湖北黄陂县。我在家乡私塾读书十年，17岁时在一所小学担任初级教员。25岁时，我在武昌加入黎元洪督统麾下的中国军队，担任列兵。两年后，我进入武昌军校，又过两年被任命为上尉军官。1909年，我因在党会委（国民党一个组织）的活动而逃避满清当局逮捕，逃往日本。我在东京的大松体育学校学习军事训练约一年。1910年7月，我回到武昌，参加了由黎元洪发起的反满起义。1911年民国成立，我在北京受雇担任日语翻译。1913年，我回到湖北，在汉口参加了反对袁世凯的革命。1913年至1916年，我在上海躲藏，随后加入北京黎元洪的幕僚班子。1917年我在上海，1918年在湖北，参加了反对段祺瑞的革命。1920年，我参与了在福建反对陈炯明的叛乱，1924年作为贺振静（Ho Chen Ching）将军的参谋前往广州。同年，我加入了孙中山的北伐军，但因病被迫返回广州。1925年我又来到上海，不久后回到湖北加入

pages.en:
Pan Yee Lu - Page 2.

my parents in my native town of Wang Sei. In 1928 I was
in Shanghai with my family and from that time until March
1934 resided in 17, Tsung Ming Li, Hart Road. On the latter
date I removed to my present address in the Shanghai Bank
Building. I have no occupation and I receive monetary
assistance from General Ho Chen Ching, ex-Chairman of the
Hupeh Provincial Government. My wife and three of my sons
are now in Hupeh, while a fourth son named Pan Sih Lu
is employed in the Shanghai Commercial and Savings Bank,
Ningpo Road, as a clerk.

I am not a member of any communist party. The
communist books and papers found in my room were given to
me by friends. The copies of the International Press
Correspondence dated 1932 were left with me several years
ago by a friend. I have not read the communist books and
I am not interested in them.

(Signed) Pan Yee Lu.

MS
pages.zh:
潘怡如 - 第2页。

我在王寺（Wang Sei）老家的父母。1928年，我与家人
在上海，从那时起直到1934年3月，一直居住在赫德路
宗明里17号。此后我搬至目前的住所，即上海银行大厦。
我没有职业，依靠前任湖北省政府主席贺振静将军的资
助生活。我的妻子和三个儿子现在湖北，而第四个儿子
潘思鲁（Pan Sih Lu）在宁波路的上海商业储蓄银行担
任职员。

我不是任何共产党的成员。在我房间里发现的共产
主义书籍和文件是朋友给我的。1932年版的《国际新闻
通讯》是几年前一位朋友留在我这里的。我没有读过这
些共产主义书籍，对它们也不感兴趣。

（签名）潘怡如。

MS

PROCEEDINGS.
Mr. Ru:- The 1st and 2nd accused in this case were arrested on Yates Road, but no communistic literature was seized. When the 1st accused was escorted in the precincts, he threw away one cigarette packet on to the ground; D.S. Gezeley picked the packet up and found it containing a piece of paper with very small character on it, that has been enlarged by photograph (produced). The 3rd and 4th accused were arrested on Avenue Road and a great quantity of communistic literatures were seized in their house. The 5th accused was arrested on Connaught Road and a great quantity of communistic literatures were also seized in his home. Lists of Exhibits were produced to Court in last hearing. The police has no objection for handing over of the 1st, 3rd & 5th accused, as they are suspected being concerned in communistic activities. I would like to ask the Court to have a consideration, whether or not, the 2nd & 4th accused should also be handed over. When the 1st and 2nd accused were arrested, the police located two children who are now temporarily kept by the chief tenant of the house.

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

Summary of evidence against Chow Han Ping
(周漢平) and Lee Sieu Lay (李秀蘭).

On July 24, 1935 on the authority of a warrant issued at the request of the Public Safety Bureau detectives visited House 15, Lane 302, Yates Road, and there arrested Chow Han Ping and his wife, Lee Sieu Lay on a charge of being communists.

No literature or documents of an incriminating nature were found, but in a packet of cigarettes thrown on the floor by the male accused was found the attached document. The accused snatched it from the hand of a detective who was examing it and attempted to destroy it, and when it was taken from him his wife attempted to snatch it. The efforts of the two accused to obtain possession of and destroy the document indicates that both were aware of the incriminating nature of its contents.

Charge Writ of Detention in accordance with Art.s 42 & 60 of the C.C.P.R.O
Application is hereby made to the S.S.D. Court for a writ of detention against the five above named accused who were arrested at divers addresses in the International Settlement on 24/7/35, upon suspicion of being concerned in communistic activities on and prior to 24/7/35.

2nd Branch of Xiangshang High Court.

PROCEEDINGS.
Mr. Ru appeared for the S.M.C.
Mr. Ru:- The police ask for the detention of these accused who were arrested the request of Public Safety Bureau on the authority of Search Warrant Nos. 7458, 7459 & 7461 and Warrant Nos. 7455 & 7456 on suspicion of being concerned in communistic activities.
The 1st & 2nd accused were arrested at 15/302 Yates Road and nothing incriminating was found in their room. When the 1st accused was searched in his house, I found one cigarette packet containing one small piece of paper with very small characters on it. This small piece of paper has been sent to the Special Branch. The 3rd & 4th accused were arrested at 1330 Nanking Road and a quantity of communistic literature were found in their room. I have here a list of the exhibits (produced) for your perusal. The 5th accused was arrested at 89 Connaught Road, and a quantity of communistic Hsinking literature were also seized in his room. List of exhibits produced.
I ask the Court that all the accused be detained in custody for further investigation. All the accused have made statements at the Police Station (Produced).

Daung Yao, Insp. of P.S.B.:- Acting on information, I arrested these accused with the assistance of S.M. Police. I ask that they are to be detained pending further enquiries.

1st accused:- I am not a member of communist. The small piece of paper found by police is a rough copy of letter written by my friend. I was not in possession of the cigarette packets, and I don't know where the police found it.

现向江苏高等法院第二分院申请对上述五名被告发出拘留令，该五人于1935年7月24日在公共租界多处地址被捕，涉嫌参与1935年7月24日及之前的共产主义活动。

江苏高等法院第二分院。

诉讼程序。
Ru 先生代表工部局出席。
Ru 先生:- 警方请求拘留这些被告，他们是应公共安全局的要求，依据搜查令编号 7458、7459 和 7461 以及逮捕令编号 7455 和 7456，因涉嫌参与共产主义活动而被捕的。
第一和第二被告在耶茨路15弄302号被捕，在其房间内未发现任何定罪性质的物品。当在第一被告家中进行搜身时，我发现一个香烟盒，里面有一张写有极小字迹的小纸片。这张小纸片已送交特务科。第三和第四被告在南京路1330号被捕，在其房间内发现了大量共产主义文献。我在此提交一份证物清单供您审阅。第五被告在康纳路（Connaught Road）89号被捕，其房间内也查获了大量共产主义“新京”文献。已提交证物清单。
我请求法庭将所有被告还押候审，以作进一步调查。所有被告均在捕房作了供词（已提交）。

公共安全局督察 Dong Pau:- 根据情报，我在工部局警务处的协助下逮捕了这些被告。我请求将他们拘留以待进一步查问。

第一被告:- 我不是共产党员。警察发现的那张小纸片是我朋友写的信件的草稿。我并不持有那些香烟盒，我也不知道警察是在哪里找到它的。

My name is Chow Kwai-yih, age 23, male, born at
Hangchow, Chekiang. From the time I was five years old
until I was 9 I went to an primary school and then from
the age of 9 until I was 19 I went to the Ih Tscong (一中)
Primary School, both schools are in Hangchow. When
I was 19 I went to Peking and entered the University of
Peking in order to study Mathematics. In April of 1935
I married; my wife's name is Li May Fang (李梅芳) and
when I married her she was 17 years of age. We have no
children. In March of this year I came to Shanghai and
my wife came later. When I arrived at Shanghai I was met
at the North Station by a former class mate of mine from
Peking. His name is Yu Ya-sung (俞子昇), age 27, native
of Honan, who told me that he lived at Doong Teh Fang
(同德坊), Siona Road. It was my intention to visit
my uncle Chow Ping San (周平山), 10 Ai Vung Range Avenue
Road, who is an engineer in the Ma Hai Foreign Hong (馬海洋行),
Yuen Ming Yuen Road. My uncle had promised to obtain
employment for me but on my arrival I found that he had
gone to Hangchow, and I took lodgings at the place where
I was arrested, Hyung Hung Kee Tailors' Shop, Wen Teh
Fang (渭德坊), Avenue Road. I decided to wait at this
place until my uncle returned. I had been in Shanghai
a week when my friend Yu Ya-sung came to see me. He
suggested that I should join the communist party and I
agreed to consider the matter. He gave me a book written
in English by "Smedly" (1) entitled "China Red Army Marches"
pages.zh:
周贵一 (周貴一)
杭州                                      巡长 Henchman
成都路          1935年7月24日                 书记员 Wong Chia-tsing

我叫周贵一，23岁，男性，出生于浙江杭州。从五岁到九岁，我在一所小学读书，然后从九岁到十九岁，我在杭州的一中（Ih Tscong）小学读书，这两所学校都在杭州。十九岁时，我去了北京，进入北京大学学习数学。1935年4月我结婚了；我妻子的名字叫李梅芳（Li May Fang），结婚时她17岁。我们没有孩子。今年三月我来到上海，我妻子后来才来。当我到达上海时，我在北站遇到了一位我以前在北京的同学。他叫俞子昇（Yu Ya-sung），27岁，河南人，他告诉我他住在西摩路（Siona Road）同德坊（Doong Teh Fang）。我本打算去拜访我的叔叔周平山（Chow Ping San），他住在爱文义路10号爱文义公寓（Ai Vung Range Avenue Road），他是圆明园路马海洋行（Ma Hai Foreign Hong）的工程师。我叔叔曾答应为我找工作，但我到达后发现他已去杭州，于是我在被捕的地方，即爱文义路渭德坊（Wen Teh Fang）亨鸿记裁缝店（Hyung Hung Kee Tailors' Shop）寄宿。我决定在这个地方等我叔叔回来。我在上海呆了一周后，我的朋友俞子昇来看我。他建议我加入共产党，我同意考虑此事。他给了我一本由“史沫特莱”（Smedly）(1) 用英文写的书，题为《中国红军长征记》（China Red Army Marches）

pages.en:
- 2 -
and last Wednesday he gave me some envelopes which he
told me not to open and which I have not opened. This
was the last time I saw him, he told me he was coming
again next Sunday or Monday. Apart from him I have
no other communistic friends and before coming to Shanghai
I had no connection or interest in communist activities.
My friend said that when I had finished reading the book
he had given me I was to translate it into Chinese and
that I might prove of use to the Communist cause as a translator
I know no other communists in Shanghai and I am not in
communication with anyone. My wife is not engaged in
communistic activities.

Signed Chow Kwei-yih.
pages.zh:
- 2 -
上周三，他给了我一些信封，嘱咐我不要拆开，我也确实没有拆开。这是我最后一次见到他，他说下个星期日或星期一还会再来。除了他之外，我没有其他共产主义朋友，在来上海之前，我与共产主义活动没有任何联系或兴趣。我的朋友说，等我读完他给我的那本书后，要将其翻译成中文，说我作为一名翻译或许能对共产主义事业有所用处。我在上海不认识其他共产党人，也没有与任何人保持联络。我的妻子不参与共产主义活动。

周桂义（Chow Kwei-yih）签字。

pages.en:
Chow Han-ping (周汗平 ), age 25.
Pien Kwan (偏關 ) D.S. Poole
Chengtu Road 24/7/36 Clerk Wong Chin-tsing

I am residing at Lane 302, No.15 Yates Road.
I was born during December, 1910, in Pien Kwan,
Shansi, where my father was a piece goods merchant. When
I was eight years of age I went to a small private school
studying there and at my home until I was 14. I then went
to the Pien Kwan Hsien Government Primary School remaining
there until I was 17. Then with the financial backing
of my father I established a mixed goods shop at my native
place. My father died during the next year. When I
reached 20 years of age my own business being bad I took
a position in a Gasoline Company in Fengtien, where I
李秀蘭
was introduced to me one Lee Siou Lay whom I married in
August, 1930.(This is the women who was arrested with me).
We lived in Fengtien until December, 1934, when I came to
Shanghai to look for work. I know nothing of communism
and am not a communist. The paper which the detective found
in my cigarette packet was a letter from a girl friend
of mine which I did not wish anyone to see as it was of a personal
personal nature that is why I snatched it from the detective.
I have lived at my present address ever since. I first
came to Shanghai going there from a lodging house the
name and location of which I cannot remember.

Signed Chow Han-ping.
pages.zh:
周汗平（Chow Han-ping），年龄25岁。
籍贯：偏關 (Pien Kwan) D.S. Poole
成都路 1936年7月24日 职员 黄钦清（Wong Chin-tsing）

我现居住于耶茨路（Yates Road）15号302弄。
我于1910年12月出生于山西偏關，父亲是一名布匹商人。我八岁时进入一所小型私塾读书，在那里以及家中学习直至十四岁。随后我进入偏關县政府小学就读，一直读到十七岁。之后在父亲的资助下，我在家乡开设了一家杂货店。次年父亲去世。当我二十岁时，因自家生意不佳，我便在奉天的一家汽油公司谋得职位，在那里
李秀蘭
有人向我介绍了李秀兰（Lee Siou Lay），我于1930年8月与她结婚。（这就是与我一同被捕的女子）。
我们在奉天居住至1934年12月，当时我来上海找工作。我对共产主义一无所知，也不是共产党员。侦探在我香烟盒里发现的那张纸是我一位女性朋友的来信，因内容涉及个人隐私，我不愿让他人看见，这就是我之所以从侦探手中夺回信件的原因。
自那时起我一直居住在目前的地址。我初到上海时，是从一家旅馆前往此处的，但该旅馆的名称和地点我已记不清了。

周汗平（Chow Han-ping）签字。

pages.en:
Shun Koo Tung (沈国棟), age 19.
Wusih D.S. Pools
Chengtu Road 24/7/35

I am residing at 80 Connaught Road. I was
born during August, 1916 at Wusih, where my father was a
flour shop owner. When I was seven years of age I went to
the Sung Lih School (省立無錫中学) of Wusih studying there
until I was 16. I then stayed at my home for the next
6 months, when I came to Shanghai taking up residence
at Route Siccawei, Siau Yeu Li, No.80. At this time I
was employed by the Siau Er Doong Press as a proof-reader,
in which capacity I am still employed. I late removed
to 254 Foochow Road, which address I vacated at the
beginning of July, 1935, removing to my present address.
I know nothing of communism and all the books, etc., which
were found in my room I was looking after for a fellow
孫伯良
townsman named Sun Poh Liang, who has returned to Wusih.
I do not know his address.

Signed Shun Koo Tung.
pages.zh:
沈国棟（Shun Koo Tung），年龄19岁。
籍贯：无锡 (Wusih) D.S. Pools
成都路 1935年7月24日

我现居住于康纳脱路（Connaught Road）80号。我于1916年8月出生于无锡，父亲是一家面粉店的店主。我七岁时进入无锡的省立无锡中学（Sung Lih School）就读，一直读到十六岁。随后我在家中待了六个月，之后来到上海，起初居住在徐家汇小姚里（Siau Yeu Li, Route Siccawei）80号。当时我受雇于小二东印刷所（Siau Er Doong Press）担任校对员，至今仍在此职位工作。后来我搬至福州路254号，并于1935年7月初搬离该处，迁至现址。
我对共产主义一无所知，在我房间内发现的所有书籍等物品，都是替一位名叫孙伯良（Sun Poh Liang）的同乡保管的，他已返回无锡。我不知道他的地址。
孫伯良

沈国棟（Shun Koo Tung）签字。

pages.en:
Lee May Fong (李梅芳 ), age 19.
Wusih, Kiangsu                                      D.S. Poole
Chengtu Road                24/7/35

My name is Lee May Fong.    I am residing at
1560 Avenue Road.
    I was born in July, 1917, in Wusih where my father
is a farmer.    As I was a delicate child and always suffered
with heart trouble I couldnot study until I was 12 years
of age when I went to the Wusih Primary School remaining
there until I was 15.    I then became ill again and had to
remain at my home until January, 1933, when I went to the
Vung Li School (文理学校) in Peking to continue my studies.
While I was at this school I met one Chow Kwai Yih whom
I later married during April, 1933.    We stayed together
in Peiping until March, 1935, when my husband came to
Shanghai to get work.    I did not come to Shanghai until
about a month ago when I went to the address where I
was arrested, to live with my husband.    I know nothing
at all about communism.

                                        Signed Lee May Fong.
pages.zh:
李梅芳，19岁。
江苏无锡                                      D.S. Poole
成都路                1935年7月24日

我叫李梅芳。现居住于
爱文义路1560号。
    我于1917年7月出生在无锡，我的父亲
是一名农民。由于我自幼体弱，且一直患有
心脏病，直到12岁才得以入学，进入无锡小学就读，
并在那里读到15岁。随后我再次生病，不得不
在家休养，直至1933年1月，我前往北平的文理学校
继续学业。在这所学校期间，我结识了周桂义（音译），
并于1933年4月与他结婚。我们在北平共同生活
至1935年3月，当时我的丈夫来上海找工作。我直到
大约一个月前才来到上海，前往我被捕时的地址，
与丈夫同住。我对共产主义一无所知。

                                        李梅芳 签名

pages.en:
Lee Sieu Lay (李秀南), age 23.
Fengtien                                      D.S. Poole
Chengtu Road          24/7/35                 Clerk: Wong Chia-tsing

I am residing at Lane 302, No.15 Yates Road.
I was born during May, 1912 in Fengtien, where my
father was a small shop-keeper (i.e. mixed goods shop).
I stayed at my home until I was 11 years old when I went
to a private school in Fengtien for the next three years.
I then went back to my home where I stayed until I was
18. At this age I was introduced to Chow Han Ping
(周漢平) (my present husband) by a mutual friend.
Chow was at that time employed in a gasoline firm. On
August 15, 1930 I was married to this man and stayed in
Fengtien with him until December, 1934, when we both came
to Shanghai with our only child to look for work. I
know nothing of communism and I know nothing of my
husbands business.

                                          Signed Lee Sieu Lay.
pages.zh:
李秀南，23岁。
奉天                                      D.S. Poole
成都路          1935年7月24日                 书记员：Wong Chia-tsing

我现居住于耶茨路15号302弄。
我于1912年5月出生在奉天，当时我的父亲是一名小店主（即杂货店）。
我在家里待到11岁，随后在奉天的一所私塾读了三年书。
之后我回到家中，一直住到18岁。在这个年纪，经一位共同朋友介绍，我认识了周漢平（我现在的丈夫）。
周当时受雇于一家汽油公司。1930年8月15日，我与此人结婚，并同他一起留在奉天，直到1934年12月，我们带着唯一的孩子一同来到上海谋职。我对共产主义一无所知，对我丈夫的业务也一无所知。

                                          签名：李秀南

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
========================================
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.
========================================

The following supplementary is the/statement of Tseu Kwei Ih (周贯一)
native of Hangchow taken by me
at Public Safety on the 29.7.35. and interpreted by
Bureau.

My name is Tseu Kwei Ih, age 23, native of Hangchow.
I joined the Chinese Communist Youth League in May, 1933.
In February this year I was instructed to leave Peiping
for Shanghai to continue my work. I was arrested by the
Municipal Police on July 24, 1935 and was later escorted
to the Public Safety Bureau. This is my true statement.

Signed: Tseu Kwei Ih.

年因工作於今年二月沈庵工作於本月廿の日英和号被
捕到公安局供認是實

周費一
七月廿九日

Form 40
G. 15,000-10-33

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

supplementary
The following is the statement of Tseu Han Ping (周漢平)
native of Shansi taken by me
at P.S.B. on the 29.7.35. and interpreted by

My name is Tseu Han Ping, age 25, native of Pien
Kwan, Shansi Province. I have been in the Chinese
Communist Youth League for one year. I came to Shanghai
up
in December last year and took my residence at No. 15
Hwa Zung Li (華顺里), Yates Road. I was arrested
on July 24, 1935. I am willing to reform. This
is my true statement.

Signed: Tseu Han Ping.
pages.zh:

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
警务调查报告。

补充材料
以下为周漢平（Tseu Han Ping）之陈述，系本人于 1935 年 7 月 29 日在巡捕房（P.S.B.）对其所作讯问记录，并由……翻译

本人名周漢平，现年 25 岁，籍贯山西省边关（Pien Kwan）。加入中国共产主义青年团已有一年。去年十二月来沪，寓居亚尔培路（Yates Road）華顺里 15 号。于 1935 年 7 月 24 日被捕。本人愿意改过自新。此乃本人真实供词。

签名：周漢平。
